tips: No single fault stands out: 11 m went before the mark and 83 m after. Same routine, a little smoother, to close the gap to your best.
Came out at 45° to the wind, low and wide (your best exited at 25°). Finish the turn close to close-hauled; the wide entry is what makes a tight exit possible.
Passed 8 m from the mark. Wide in, tight out: leave it about a boat length (3 m) away on the exit.
Tacked 50 s after the mark, so its cost is in this number. Fine if it was for clear air or the favoured side; otherwise hold the lane until you're up to speed.
Speed dropped 29% through the turn (5.71 → 4.05 kt; best 5%). A smoother, rounder turn with trim in step with the helm keeps more of it.
